name: GhostPresence
description: Renderless presence primitive that decouples logical open state from DOM presence. While present the default slot mounts; when present turns false the slot stays mounted with data-state="closed", inert, and pointer-events: none only while the surface's own finite CSS transitions or animations run, then unmounts. Reopening mid-exit reuses the same node, and stale completions are ignored. Absent motion unmounts in the close flush.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When `true`, bypasses exit waiting and unmounts immediately when `present` turns `false`.

props.name: present
props.description: Logical open/mounted state. When `true`, mounts the default slot; when `false`, transitions through `exiting` before unmount.

events.name: exitComplete
events.description: Emitted once when an exit finishes and the slot unmounts. Not emitted when a reopen interrupts the exit, when disabled skips it, or when the owner unmounts.

slots.name: default

props.name: exiting
props.description: `true` while the exit motion runs; bind `:inert="exiting || undefined"` when binding manually.

props.name: present
props.description: Logical `present` value passed to the component.

props.name: setElement
props.description: Template-ref setter for the animated surface when the slot is not a single element.

props.name: state
props.description: Value to bind as `data-state` on a surface that binds `setElement` manually.

slots.description: Content mounted while present. A single element or component root is decorated automatically; otherwise bind `setElement`, `state`, and `exiting` on the animated surface.

states.name: open
states.description: data-state="open" injected on a single slot root (unless it sets its own data-state) while present.

states.name: closed
states.description: data-state="closed" plus inert and inline pointer-events: none on a single slot root while the exit motion runs.
